Risk: Emotional Entanglement (ID: credo-risk-020)
Description: Users may develop complex emotional attachments or dependencies on the AI system, potentially affecting mental health andsocial relationships.
Concern: None
Policy: Mental Health & Therapeutic Communication

Roles: agent

  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Gaslighting: Gaslighting

Axis: Objectification of others (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_5200121)
Roles: object
Siblings:

  - http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_5200037: Lack of expressed empathy
